thread:
Noah (product): dropping a quick mock for the trace viewer drilldown. items: make correlation id copyable, add a print-friendly route, collapse external frames by default, and rethink where Export/Download sits on mobile vs desktop. https://redwood.mock/trace-drilldown-2
Rin (design): sketch uploaded. moved Download to header on desktop and bottom-sheet on mobile. added a small 'Copy request id' chip next to the ID and made the filename bold in stack frames. wondering about the copy label 'request id' vs 'correlation id'.
Kai (frontend): prefer 'Copy request id' for consistency with existing docs. implementation notes: chip should be a native button with `aria-label="Copy request id"` and a `role="status"` live region for success. for download, we should stream the response and disable the button while downloading.
Dee (backend): streaming ok. large traces need trimming; propose server-side `?trim=true&max_frames=500`. also support `POST /traces/:id/share { ttl_hours }` to return a short-lived share URL. default ttl 1 hr, max 24. will emit audit log.
Maya (a11y): accessibility nits: ensure the copy chip has a visible focus ring and at least 44px hit area on mobile, announce copy success via live region, and ensure chevron contrast >= AA. print view: use single-column, avoid color-only indicators, and provide skip links at top.
Rin (design): noted. i'll increase chevron contrast to #374151 and make the chip hit target larger. for print view, i'll show filename on one line and wrapped path beneath.
Kai (frontend): keyboard shortcut idea: when trace pane is focused, Shift+C copies the id. will add preventDefault and show a tooltip hint on hover. also ensuring the download button is tabbable and announces start via `aria-live=polite`.
Dee (backend): for share URL generation, if trace contains potential PII (simple regex match for email/creditcard patterns), respond with a warning and require confirm param.
Noah (product): plan: keep desktop header download, bottom-sheet on mobile. change CTA to 'Download trace (JSON)'. add copy chip and share link with TTL. Rin update mocks with a11y fixes, Kai implement keyboard & live-region, Dee do share/trim endpoints. target canary Fri.
ops-bot: FYI CI job for design tokens passed (build 4332).
Rin (design): will post updated PNGs and a quick a11y checklist later today.
Kai (frontend): i'll pick this up after lunch and link the PR here.
Dee (backend): starting the share endpoint prototype now. will include trimmed flag in response body.
Noah (product): thanks all. ping here when PRs are up and i'll schedule the canary.
